theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_cp_translation_invariant_of_fderiv
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (v : Euclid P), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ν K < ∞) → (∀ φ : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∫ y, fderiv ℝ φ y v ∂ν = 0) → ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → ν ((fun x => v + x) ⁻¹' A) = ν A
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
